research: This catalog's own Data Security, Privacy & Classification course (access governance, RBAC, least privilege, masking, encryption, data subject requests) and AI & Machine Learning Governance course (model documentation/model cards, training data governance, bias in data, AI incident response) — this lesson synthesizes those courses' concepts into interview-scenario form rather than introducing new claims

General, widely-known regulatory facts referenced only at a plain-language level (GDPR as the EU's broad personal-data regulation, CCPA as a California resident-rights law) — no specific statute text or legal advice given
note: Interview-prep/career-advice lesson with no real product UI to screenshot. All slides are original LTV-authored steps diagrams and one original code-style sample-answer card, consistent with this chapter's other interview-prep lessons. No screenshots used or needed.
